shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage remote server certificates.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: certificates
options.description: List of certificate files Each item must include the path to the file

options.name: reload_certificates
options.description: Whether to reload certificates when certificates have been added or removed. Certificates will not be available or removed until the servers have been reloaded.

options.name: remove_unspecified_user_certificates
options.description: Whether to remove user install client certificates that are not specified in I(certificates).

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.
